build_node_to_edge_wigner_permute_kernel: build a Triton kernel wrapper that permutes node features to edge features using Wigner D-matrices
build_edge_to_node_wigner_permute_kernel: build a Triton kernel wrapper that permutes edge features back to node features using inverse Wigner D-matrices
refactor_node_to_edge_wigner_bwd_dx_kern: refactor the backward kernel for node-to-edge Wigner permutation to compute per-edge gradients with respect to input
review_edge_to_node_wigner_bwd_dx_kernel: review the backward kernel for edge-to-node Wigner permutation that computes gradients with respect to edge input
review_edge_to_node_wigner_bwd_dw_kernel: review the backward kernel for edge-to-node Wigner permutation that computes gradients with respect to Wigner matrix weights
